note: Route by route and family by family, what it would take to migrate each retired legacy jurisdiction onto Grade-A fulfillment. Authority: ADR-0004 and data/record-clearing/legal-decisions/2026-08-28-legacy-generator-retirement.json. A state is never reopened because one of its routes passes; each row is migrated on its own evidence.
whatMigrationMeans: A versioned, hashed packet specification for the family, drawn from the owner-approved packet set and the compiled profile's extracted rules.
Composition through the Grade-A composer, which refuses a matter with any required fact missing.
Rendering through the Grade-A provider to application/pdf.

A fulfillment record naming the specification hash, the source identities and their verification states, the provider and renderer with versions, the required facts, the final-verification requirements, the artifact-approval status and both postures.
Counsel review before either posture opens. Machine verification is not review.

readinessVocabulary.NO_APPROVED_PACKET_SET: There is no owner-approved packet set to migrate a specification from. Producing one is legal-design work, not build work.
readinessVocabulary.SOURCE_BYTES_NOT_MATERIALIZED_IN_CURRENT: Its owner-approved packet set fills an official PDF.
